description: AsterLab single-source-of-truth compact extraction schemas and Trigger Descriptors shared by Go runtime (ExpandCompactSlot), Jev/GLiClass/GLiNER2 routing, and Colab distillation pipelines.
global_negative_boundary: Never suggest an interactive widget for routine manual actions (washing 2x, pipetting 3x, aspirating supernatant), static reagent storage (-20C freezer), study objectives, passage/confluence observations (P5, 85%), or post-hoc discussion/troubleshooting notes even when they contain numbers or units.

targets.title: 循环计时器
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence specifies alternating multi-phase timed operations repeated for multiple rounds/cycles (e.g., 80°C water bath 5 min alternating with ice 10 min for 3 rounds).
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Single fixed incubation without alternating phases, or routine washing/pipetting repeated N times without timed phases.

slots.desc: 阶段元组数组 [[阶段名(text), 数值(number), 单位(s|min|h)], ...]

targets.example_zh: 80°C 水浴 5 min 与冰上 10 min 交替 3 轮至澄清
targets.example_en: Alternate 80°C water bath 5 min and ice 10 min for 3 cycles until clear

targets.title: 倒计时器
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence specifies a single fixed-duration active incubation, centrifugation, crosslinking, or resting step (e.g., incubate 30 min at 37°C, spin 5 min).
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Long-term reagent storage (store at -20°C for 6 months), multi-round alternating cycles, or untimed manual actions.

slots.desc: 定时时长 [数值, 单位(s|min|h)]

targets.example_zh: 37°C 培养箱孵育 30 min 使其充分聚合成胶
targets.example_en: Incubate at 37°C for 30 min for gel polymerization

targets.title: 正计时秒表
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence describes an open-ended operation timed manually until a visual/physical endpoint is reached and elapsed seconds/minutes should be recorded.
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Fixed known countdown duration or passive observation without timing.
targets.example_zh: 405 nm 蓝光照射直至水凝胶完全固化，记录实际固化秒数
targets.example_en: Irradiate with 405 nm blue light until fully gelled and record elapsed seconds

targets.title: 时间锚点等待窗
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence defines a minimum waiting/soaking window (>= 2 h) or post-anchor follow-up timepoint schedule (e.g., t0 + 6h / 12h / 24h imaging).
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Short continuous bench countdown or static storage note.

slots.desc: 偏移/最小等待时长 [数值, 单位(min|h)]

targets.example_zh: 4°C 完全培养基浸泡平衡至少 2 小时（可并行处理其他实验）
targets.example_en: Equilibrate in complete medium at 4°C for at least 2 hours

targets.title: 溶液稀释计算器 (C₁V₁=C₂V₂)
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence requires calculating stock volume and diluent volume to dilute a known stock concentration to a target concentration and final volume (C1V1 = C2V2).
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Simple fixed addition without dilution math (e.g., add 1 mL PBS) or discussing historical concentration results.

slots.desc: 母液浓度 [数值, 单位]
目标浓度 [数值, 单位]
配制终体积 [数值, 单位]

targets.example_zh: 将 100 ug/mL VEGF 母液稀释至 50 ng/mL，共配制 5 mL 工作液
targets.example_en: Dilute 100 ug/mL VEGF stock to 50 ng/mL in 5 mL final volume

targets.title: 称量配液计算器
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence requires calculating solid powder mass (mg/g) to weigh from a target % w/v or molar concentration (with MW) and target solution volume.
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Stating storage of leftover powder or quoting an already-weighed historical amount without preparation math.

slots.desc: 目标浓度 [数值, % w/v 或 mM]
分子量 [数值, g/mol] (摩尔模式必填)

targets.example_zh: 配制 5% w/v GelMA 前驱液 2 mL，计算需称取的冻干粉质量
targets.example_en: Prepare 2 mL of 5% w/v GelMA precursor solution and compute powder mass

targets.title: 孔板预混液计算器
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence scales per-well/per-reaction reagent volumes across multiple wells/reactions, typically with an overage percentage.
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Defining plate group layout without reagent scaling math.
targets.example_zh: 24 孔板预混液（多配 15% 余量）：每孔 2x Mix 10 uL、引物 1.6 uL、水 6.4 uL
targets.example_en: 24-well mastermix with 15% overage: 10 uL 2x Mix per well

targets.title: 细胞接种计算器
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence requires computing cell suspension volume and media top-up from measured cell density, target cells/well, volume/well, and well count.
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Reporting cell passage/confluence observation (e.g., P5, 85% confluent) without seeding math.
targets.example_zh: 实测 HUVEC 悬液密度 5e5 cells/mL，每孔接种 5e4 细胞（500 uL/孔），共 12 孔加 2 孔余量
targets.example_en: Seed 5e4 HUVEC/well in 500 uL across 14 wells from 5e5 cells/mL stock

targets.title: 孔板 + 实验分组
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence defines multi-well plate format (4/6/12/24/48/96/384 wells) together with experimental treatment groups, controls/blanks, and replicate counts.
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Merely mentioning a past plate contamination/result in discussion, or imaging FOV count on an existing plate.

slots.desc: 分组元组 [[组名(text), 复孔数(count), 角色(treatment|control|blank)], ...]

targets.example_zh: 12 孔板，3% / 5% / 7% GelMA 各 3 个技术复孔，第 4 列加无菌 PBS 作空白对照
targets.example_en: 12-well plate with 3%/5%/7% GelMA in triplicates and PBS blank in column 4

targets.title: 孔板采图网格
targets.when_to_suggest: Sentence defines systematic multi-well microscopy or imaging capture specifying wells and number of fields-of-view (FOVs) or fluorescence channels per well.
targets.when_not_to_suggest: Discussing a single past image finding or stating only a follow-up imaging timepoint schedule (6h/12h/24h) without FOV/channel capture slots.

slots.desc: 采图条件说明 (如 10× 明场 / DAPI+GFP)

targets.example_zh: 对 A1-C3 共 9 个孔进行 10× 明场采图，每孔随机拍 6 个非重叠视野（共 54 张）
targets.example_en: Capture 6 non-overlapping 10x brightfield FOVs per well across 9 wells (A1-C3)
